name: SEO Batch Edit Hero
author: devherodigital

sections.description:
SEO Batch Edit Hero is a powerful workflow tool for rapidly updating SEO Titles, Focus Keyphrases, Meta Descriptions, and Featured Image ALT Tags — all from a single, streamlined interface.

Built specifically for sites using Yoast SEO, this plugin eliminates the need for CSV imports or post-by-post editing. Instead, it provides practical batch tools for managing SEO data across:

  • Posts
  • Pages
  • WooCommerce Products
  • Featured Image ALT Tags

SEO Batch Edit Hero is ideal for content managers, developers, SEO professionals, and site owners managing medium to large WordPress websites.

Key Features:

  • Batch edit Yoast SEO fields (Title, Focus Keyphrase, Meta Description)
  • Manage ALT text for Featured Images across supported post types
  • Use dynamic variables such as %%title%%, %%excerpt%%, %%category%%, and more
  • Filter content by Post Type and Category
  • Pagination support for large websites (50 items per page)
  • Automatic WooCommerce detection (when installed)
  • Clean, branded dashboard with built-in usage guidance

Requirements

  • Yoast SEO must be installed and active to batch edit SEO Title, Meta Description, and Focus Keyphrase fields.
  • WooCommerce is optional. If installed and active, the plugin will also enable batch editing for WooCommerce Products.
  • Posts, Pages, and ALT Image Tag tools function independently of WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via the WordPress dashboard or extract manually to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” screen.
  3. Navigate to “SEO Batch Edit Hero” in the admin menu.
  4. Select a content type (Posts, Pages, Woo Products, or ALT IMG Tags) to begin editing.
sections.faq:
What SEO variables can I use?

SEO Batch Edit Hero supports common Yoast SEO placeholders, including:

  • %%title%% — The post, page, or product title
  • %%sitename%% — Your website name
  • %%excerpt%% — The post or product excerpt
  • %%date%% — Publication date
  • %%category%% — Assigned category (where applicable)

Can I batch edit image ALT tags?

Yes. The ALT IMG Tags section allows you to view and update ALT text for featured images across supported content types, with filters and pagination for efficient workflows.

Will the plugin work if WooCommerce is not installed?

Yes. WooCommerce-related features are conditionally loaded and hidden unless WooCommerce is active.

Does this plugin support other SEO plugins like Rank Math?

Not at this time. SEO Batch Edit Hero is currently designed specifically for Yoast SEO.
